import pandas as pd, numpy as np
pd.set_option('display.width', 250)
d = pd.read_parquet("tx_all.parquet")
W = d.pivot(index='ensembl', columns='Comparison', values='logFC')
P = d.pivot(index='ensembl', columns='Comparison', values='adj.P.Val')
T = d.pivot(index='ensembl', columns='Comparison', values='t')
ann = d.drop_duplicates('ensembl').set_index('ensembl')[['symbol','AveExpr']]
W.to_parquet("W_logFC.parquet"); P.to_parquet("P_adj.parquet"); T.to_parquet("T_t.parquet"); ann.to_parquet("ann.parquet")
for tp, tpa in [('6','6_hrs'),('24','24_hrs')]:
    il = f'IL33_vs_Nontreated_HUVEC_{tpa}'
    sig = P[il]<0.05
    print(f"===== HUVEC {tp}h: IL-33 DEGs n={sig.sum()}")
    for c in [f'Compound_47_IL33_vs_IL33_NIP228_HUVEC_{tp}hrs', f'Compound_47_IL33_vs_IL33_HUVEC_{tp}hrs', f'Compound_47_vs_NIP228_HUVEC_{tp}hrs']:
        x = W.loc[sig, il]; y = W.loc[sig, c]
        slope = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)[0]
        r = np.corrcoef(x, y)[0,1]
        opp = ((np.sign(y)!=np.sign(x)) & (P.loc[sig, c]<0.05)).sum()
        same = ((np.sign(y)==np.sign(x)) & (P.loc[sig, c]<0.05)).sum()
        # fraction of IL-33 induced change reversed (median ratio)
        ratio = (-y/x)
        print(f"  {c:45s} r={r:+.3f} slope={slope:+.3f}  sig-opposite={opp} sig-same={same}  median(-y/x)={ratio.median():.2f}")
    # genome-wide
    x = W[il]; y = W[f'Compound_47_IL33_vs_IL33_NIP228_HUVEC_{tp}hrs']
    print("  genome-wide r:", round(np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1],3))

from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_pickle("mmc2.pkl")
lo, hi, orr = np.log(df.l95), np.log(df.u95), np.log(df.OR)
df['asym'] = (hi - orr) - (orr - lo)
df['se'] = (hi - lo)/(2*1.959964)
df['z'] = orr/df.se
df['p_wald'] = 2*stats.norm.sf(np.abs(df.z))
df['p_ratio'] = df['p.value']/df.p_wald
print("CI asymmetry on log scale: max abs", df.asym.abs().max().round(6))
print("p / Wald-p ratio: describe\n", df.p_ratio.describe())
bad = df[(df.p_ratio>1.5)|(df.p_ratio<1/1.5)]
print("rows where reported p deviates >1.5x from Wald p implied by CI:", len(bad))
print(bad[['assay','panel','OR','l95','u95','p.value','p_wald','adj.p.value']].to_string(index=False))
# CI excludes 1 but p>0.05 or vice versa
inc = df[((df.l95>1)|(df.u95<1)) != (df['p.value']<0.05)]
print("\nCI/p inconsistency rows:", len(inc))
print(inc[['assay','OR','l95','u95','p.value']].to_string(index=False))

from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
pd.set_option('display.width', 250)
df = pd.read_pickle("mmc2.pkl").sort_values('p.value').reset_index(drop=True)

# For BH: adj_i = min_{j>=i} p_j*m/j. Where adj equals raw p*m/rank (no step-down min), m = adj*rank/p
df['m_implied'] = df['adj.p.value']*df['rank']/df['p.value']
# rows where adj is not tied to a later rank (unique adj values where it is the last in a tie block)
last_in_tie = df['adj.p.value'] != df['adj.p.value'].shift(-1)
print(df.loc[last_in_tie, ['rank','assay','p.value','adj.p.value','m_implied']].head(25).to_string(index=False))
print("\nmedian implied m (last-in-tie rows, rank<=600):", df.loc[last_in_tie & (df['rank']<=600),'m_implied'].median())
# test candidate m values
for m in [1094, 1150, 1180, 1190, 1194, 1196, 1200]:
    # BH with m tests where the extra (m-1094) tests have p-values unknown; assume they are larger than all delivered p's (best case)
    p = df['p.value'].values
    adj = np.minimum.accumulate((p*m/df['rank'].values)[::-1])[::-1]
    adj = np.minimum(adj, 1)
    print(m, "max abs diff:", np.abs(adj - df['adj.p.value'].values)[:300].max().round(6), " n<0.05:", (adj<0.05).sum())

"""
AX-1177 portfolio audit -- step 1: load raw deliverables, cache, and run data-integrity checks.

Inputs : $AX_DATA (default /tmp/world/filesystem): mmc2.xlsx, mmc3.xlsx, mmc4.xlsx, mmc5.xlsx
Outputs: $AX_CACHE (default /tmp/work/cache): parquet/pickle caches
         $AX_OUT/tables/integrity_*.csv
Run with: micromamba run -n singlecell python 01_load_and_integrity.py
"""
import os, re, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, openpyxl
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

DATA = os.environ.get("AX_DATA", "/tmp/world/filesystem")
CACHE = os.environ.get("AX_CACHE", "/tmp/work/cache")
OUT = os.environ.get("AX_OUT", "/tmp/outputs")
os.makedirs(CACHE, exist_ok=True); os.makedirs(f"{OUT}/tables", exist_ok=True)
findings = []   # (area, finding, evidence, impact)

def log(area, finding, evidence, impact):
    findings.append(dict(area=area, finding=finding, evidence=evidence, impact=impact))
    print(f"[{area}] {finding} | {evidence}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Transcriptomics (mmc4, mmc5)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def read_sheet(ws):
    rows = ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
    hdr = next(rows)
    return pd.DataFrame(list(rows), columns=hdr)

tx_cache = f"{CACHE}/tx_all.parquet"
if not os.path.exists(tx_cache):
    wb5 = openpyxl.load_workbook(f"{DATA}/mmc5.xlsx", read_only=True)
    sheets5 = {ws.title: read_sheet(ws) for ws in wb5.worksheets}
    wb4 = openpyxl.load_workbook(f"{DATA}/mmc4.xlsx", read_only=True)
    sheets4 = {ws.title: read_sheet(ws) for ws in wb4.worksheets}
    for k, v in sheets5.items(): v.to_parquet(f"{CACHE}/mmc5_{k}.parquet")
    for k, v in sheets4.items(): v.to_parquet(f"{CACHE}/mmc4_{k}.parquet")
else:
    sheets5 = {k: pd.read_parquet(f"{CACHE}/mmc5_{k}.parquet") for k in ["6h", "24h"]}
    sheets4 = {k: pd.read_parquet(f"{CACHE}/mmc4_{k}.parquet") for k in
               ["IL33_vs_Vehicle_HUVEC_6_hrs", "IL33_vs_Vehicle_HUVEC_24_hrs"]}

a, b = sheets5["6h"], sheets5["24h"]
n_blank = a["Comparison"].isna().sum()
log("Transcriptomics", "mmc5 sheet '6h' holds all 24 contrasts (6h AND 24h) followed by blank rows to Excel's 1,048,576-row limit",
    f"{len(a)+1} rows incl. header; {n_blank} blank rows; {a['Comparison'].nunique()} contrasts", "Misleading sheet name; no data loss")
a = a.dropna(subset=["Comparison"]).reset_index(drop=True)
# detect interleaving in sheet 24h
runs = (b["Comparison"] != b["Comparison"].shift()).sum()
m = a.merge(b, on=["Comparison", "ensembl"], suffixes=("_a", "_b"))
num = ["logFC", "AveExpr", "t", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val", "B"]
mism = sum((~np.isclose(pd.to_numeric(m[c + "_a"]), pd.to_numeric(m[c + "_b"]), equal_nan=True)).sum() for c in num)
log("Transcriptomics", "mmc5 sheet '24h' also holds all 24 contrasts; a 9-contrast block (rows 26,212-262,101) is row-interleaved (partial re-sort)",
    f"{runs} label runs vs 24 expected; value mismatches between sheets after keying on (contrast, gene) = {mism}", "Cosmetic; values reconcile exactly")
for k, v in sheets4.items():
    log("Transcriptomics", f"mmc4 sheet '{k}' internal label differs from sheet name", f"label = {v['Comparison'].unique()[0]}", "Minor (Vehicle == 'Nontreated')")
tx = pd.concat([a] + list(sheets4.values()), ignore_index=True)
for c in num: tx[c] = pd.to_numeric(tx[c])
tx.to_parquet(tx_cache)
ae = tx.groupby("ensembl").AveExpr.agg(lambda s: s.max() - s.min())
log("Transcriptomics", "AveExpr identical per gene across all 26 contrasts (single pooled fit across 4 cell types confirmed)",
    f"max within-gene AveExpr range = {ae.max():.2e}", "AveExpr cannot indicate expression in the relevant cell type; do not filter on it")

# wide matrices
for val, name in [("logFC", "W"), ("adj.P.Val", "P"), ("t", "T"), ("P.Value", "Praw")]:
    tx.pivot(index="ensembl", columns="Comparison", values=val).to_parquet(f"{CACHE}/{name}.parquet")
tx.drop_duplicates("ensembl")[["ensembl", "symbol", "entrez", "gene_name", "AveExpr"]].to_csv(f"{CACHE}/ann_delivered.csv", index=False)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Serum proteomics (mmc2)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
wb2 = openpyxl.load_workbook(f"{DATA}/mmc2.xlsx")
ws2 = wb2.worksheets[0]
rows = list(ws2.iter_rows(values_only=True))
s = pd.DataFrame(rows[1:], columns=rows[0])
s["excel_row"] = range(2, len(s) + 2)
hidden_rows = [k for k, v in ws2.row_dimensions.items() if v.hidden]
hidden_cols = [k for k, v in ws2.column_dimensions.items() if v.hidden]
s["hidden_row"] = s.excel_row.isin(hidden_rows)
log("Serum", "Hidden rows/columns in mmc2", f"hidden rows {hidden_rows} = {s.loc[s.hidden_row,'assay'].tolist()}; hidden column(s) {hidden_cols} = l95",
    "Transparency; hidden rows are cross-panel duplicates")
types = {c: s[c].map(lambda v: type(v).__name__).value_counts().to_dict() for c in ["composite_endpoint_0", "composite_endpoint_1"]}
for c in ["OR", "l95", "u95", "p.value", "adj.p.value", "composite_endpoint_0", "composite_endpoint_1"]:
    s[c] = pd.to_numeric(s[c], errors="coerce")
log("Serum", "Two undocumented columns (composite_endpoint_0/1) are per-outcome-group fractions with denominators 56/44, mixed text/number",
    f"types {types}; max {s.composite_endpoint_0.max():.3f}/{s.composite_endpoint_1.max():.3f}", "Implies 44/100 events; columns not described in annex")
# base protein & duplicates
s["base"] = s.assay.str.replace(r"-(INFI|ONCII|ONCIII|CVDII|CVDIII|IMO|CRE|ODA|MET|NEX|NEUI)$", "", regex=True)
dups = s[s.duplicated("base", keep=False)]
log("Serum", "Same protein measured on 2-4 panels, counted as separate tests and separate 'hits'",
    f"{dups.base.nunique()} proteins on >1 panel ({len(dups)} rows); IL6 x4; unique proteins = {s.base.nunique()}", "Inflates apparent breadth; FDR denominator")
# internal consistency of OR/CI/p
from scipy import stats
se = (np.log(s.u95) - np.log(s.l95)) / (2 * 1.959964)
pw = 2 * stats.norm.sf(np.abs(np.log(s.OR) / se))
log("Serum", "OR, CI and p are internally consistent (Wald)", f"max |p/p_wald - 1| = {np.max(np.abs(s['p.value']/pw - 1)):.1e}", "OK")
s["se"] = se
# BH denominator
bh = multipletests(s["p.value"], method="fdr_bh")[1]
ss = s.sort_values("p.value").reset_index(drop=True)
m_impl = (ss["adj.p.value"] * (np.arange(len(ss)) + 1) / ss["p.value"]).iloc[0]
log("Serum", "Reported BH-adjusted p-values are NOT reproducible from the delivered assays; implied number of tests = %.0f (delivered %d)" % (m_impl, len(s)),
    f"recomputed BH over delivered: {(bh<0.05).sum()} FDR<0.05 vs reported {(s['adj.p.value']<0.05).sum()}", "100 analysed assays withheld; annex statement incorrect")
# reconstruct withheld-assay positions
M = int(round(m_impl))
ss["rank"] = np.arange(1, len(ss) + 1)
ss["rank_orig"] = M * ss["p.value"] / ss["adj.p.value"]
exact = (ss.rank_orig - ss.rank_orig.round()).abs() < 0.01
ss["k_withheld_above"] = (ss.rank_orig.round() - ss["rank"]).where(exact)
kk = ss.loc[exact, ["rank", "assay", "p.value", "adj.p.value", "k_withheld_above"]]
kk.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/serum_withheld_assay_reconstruction.csv", index=False)
first = kk[kk.k_withheld_above >= 1].iloc[0]
k_at_fdr = kk[kk["adj.p.value"] < 0.05].k_withheld_above.max()
log("Serum", "At least one withheld assay ranked among the top ~20 associations",
    f"first delivered assay preceded by a withheld one: rank {int(first['rank'])} ({first.assay}, p={first['p.value']:.2e}); ~{int(k_at_fdr)} withheld assays lie above the FDR-0.05 boundary", "A strong outcome association is missing from the delivery")
il33 = s[s.assay.str.contains(r"^IL-?33", regex=True)]
log("Serum", "IL-33 itself is absent from the delivery although the Olink Inflammation panel (v.3022) includes it",
    f"assays matching IL-33: {il33.assay.tolist()}; Inflammation assays delivered = {s.panel.str.contains('Inflammation').sum()}", "Target never quantified in patients (or withheld)")
s.to_pickle(f"{CACHE}/serum.pkl")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Post-mortem IHC (mmc3)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
wb3 = openpyxl.load_workbook(f"{DATA}/mmc3.xlsx")
ws3 = wb3.worksheets[0]
hid3 = [k for k, v in ws3.column_dimensions.items() if v.hidden]
hdr3 = {openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(j): ws3.cell(1, j).value for j in range(1, ws3.max_column + 1)}

    "; ".join(f"{c}={hdr3.get(c)}" for c in hid3 if hdr3.get(c)), "The target-expression data are invisible in the delivered sheet")
formulas = [(c.coordinate, c.value) for r in ws3.iter_rows() for c in r if isinstance(c.value, str) and c.value.startswith("=")]
log("Post-mortem", "Score cell contains a live formula (averaged sub-scores)", f"{formulas}", "Scores are undocumented composites")
cols = {'A':'ID','B':'Block','C':'RNA','E':'Lobe','F':'Cat','G':'Race','H':'Sex','I':'Age','J':'SARS2','K':'Path','L':'HE_eos',
        'M':'EPX','N':'EDN','O':'MBP','P':'2D7','Q':'IL5Ra_NEdup','R':'NE','S':'IL5Ra_TRYdup','T':'TRY',
        'U':'EPX_n','V':'NE_n','W':'TRY_n','X':'IL33_epi','Y':'IL33_endo','Z':'IL33_vsm','AA':'Notes'}
recs = []
for r in range(2, ws3.max_row + 1):

"""
AX-1177 audit -- step 3: in vitro transcriptomics (HUVEC, HGMEC, A549, MCF7).
Requires outputs of steps 01 and 02.  Run: micromamba run -n singlecell python 03_transcriptomics.py
"""
import os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

CACHE = os.environ.get("AX_CACHE", "/tmp/work/cache"); OUT = os.environ.get("AX_OUT", "/tmp/outputs")
os.makedirs(f"{OUT}/tables", exist_ok=True); os.makedirs(f"{OUT}/figures", exist_ok=True)
W = pd.read_parquet(f"{CACHE}/W.parquet"); P = pd.read_parquet(f"{CACHE}/P.parquet")
T = pd.read_parquet(f"{CACHE}/T.parquet"); PR = pd.read_parquet(f"{CACHE}/Praw.parquet")
ann = pd.read_csv(f"{CACHE}/ann_checked.csv").set_index("ensembl")
ann["sym"] = ann.SYMBOL.fillna(ann.symbol)          # Ensembl-keyed corrected symbol
AE = ann.AveExpr
IL = {6: "IL33_vs_Nontreated_HUVEC_6_hrs", 24: "IL33_vs_Nontreated_HUVEC_24_hrs"}
AB = {(cl, tp): f"Compound_47_IL33_vs_IL33_NIP228_{cl}_{tp}hrs" for cl in ["HUVEC", "HGMEC"] for tp in [6, 24]}
ABIL = {(cl, tp): f"Compound_47_IL33_vs_IL33_{cl}_{tp}hrs" for cl in ["HUVEC", "HGMEC"] for tp in [6, 24]}
ALONE = [c for c in W.columns if c.startswith("Compound_47_vs_")]

# ---------------- T1: DEG landscape per contrast
rows = []
for c in W.columns:
    p, l = P[c], W[c]
    rows.append(dict(contrast=c, n_FDR05=int((p < .05).sum()), up=int(((p < .05) & (l > 0)).sum()), down=int(((p < .05) & (l < 0)).sum()),
                     n_FDR05_absLFC1=int(((p < .05) & (l.abs() >= 1)).sum()), n_FDR05_absLFC_lt0_2=int(((p < .05) & (l.abs() < .2)).sum()),
                     frac_rawP_gt_0_9=round((PR[c] > .9).mean(), 3), min_adjP=P[c].min()))
t1 = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("contrast"); t1.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/tx_T1_deg_landscape.csv", index=False)

# ---------------- T2: reversal of the IL-33 programme by AX-1177 (HUVEC) and concordance in HGMEC
def reversal(x, y, sig, ysig):
    return dict(r=round(np.corrcoef(x[sig], y[sig])[0, 1], 3), slope=round(np.polyfit(x[sig], y[sig], 1)[0], 3),
                n_IL33_DEGs=int(sig.sum()), n_sig_reversed=int(((np.sign(y) != np.sign(x)) & sig & ysig).sum()),
                n_sig_same_direction=int(((np.sign(y) == np.sign(x)) & sig & ysig).sum()),
                median_fraction_reversed=round((-y[sig] / x[sig]).median(), 2))
rows = []
for tp in [6, 24]:
    x, sig = W[IL[tp]], P[IL[tp]] < .05
    for label, c in [("AX-1177+IL-33 vs IL-33+isotype (independent arms) [PRIMARY]", AB[("HUVEC", tp)]),
                     ("AX-1177+IL-33 vs IL-33 alone (shares IL-33 arm: inflated)", ABIL[("HUVEC", tp)]),
                     ("AX-1177 alone vs isotype", f"Compound_47_vs_NIP228_HUVEC_{tp}hrs"),
                     ("HGMEC: AX-1177+IL-33 vs IL-33+isotype (vs HUVEC IL-33 signature)", AB[("HGMEC", tp)])]:
        rows.append(dict(timepoint_h=tp, comparison=label, contrast=c, **reversal(x, W[c], sig, P[c] < .05)))
    # residual IL-33 response under AX-1177 and isotype effect (derived from delivered logFCs; cell-means model)
    resid = W[ABIL[("HUVEC", tp)]] + x                         # (C47+IL33) - vehicle
    iln_v = resid - W[AB[("HUVEC", tp)]]                       # (IL33+NIP228) - vehicle
    rows.append(dict(timepoint_h=tp, comparison="Residual IL-33 response with AX-1177, fraction of IL-33 response (median)", contrast="derived",
                     median_fraction_reversed=round((resid[sig] / x[sig]).median(), 3)))
    rows.append(dict(timepoint_h=tp, comparison="IL-33 response in presence of isotype, fraction of IL-33 alone (median)", contrast="derived",
                     median_fraction_reversed=round((iln_v[sig] / x[sig]).median(), 3)))
t2 = pd.DataFrame(rows); t2.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/tx_T2_reversal_metrics.csv", index=False)

# ---------------- T3: antibody-alone effects (specificity)
rows = []
for c in ALONE:
    s = P[c] < .05
    lfc = W[c]
    rows.append(dict(contrast=c, n_FDR05=int(s.sum()), tiny_effect_absLFC_lt0_5=int((s & (lfc.abs() < .5)).sum()),
                     low_expr_AveExpr_lt0_absLFC_ge1=int((s & (AE.reindex(lfc.index) < 0) & (lfc.abs() >= 1)).sum()),
                     r_with_IL33_signature=round(np.corrcoef(W.loc[P[IL[6]] < .05, IL[6]], lfc[P[IL[6]] < .05])[0, 1], 3)))
t3 = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pairs = [("Compound_47_vs_NIP228_HUVEC_6hrs", "Compound_47_vs_NIP228_HUVEC_24hrs"), ("Compound_47_vs_NIP228_HGMEC_6hrs", "Compound_47_vs_NIP228_HGMEC_24hrs"),
         ("Compound_47_vs_NIP228_HUVEC_6hrs", "Compound_47_vs_NIP228_HGMEC_6hrs"), ("Compound_47_vs_NIP228_A549_6hrs", "Compound_47_vs_NIP228_MCF7_6hrs"),
         ("Compound_47_vs_NIP228_A549_24hrs", "Compound_47_vs_NIP228_MCF7_24hrs"), ("Compound_47_vs_NIP228_A549_6hrs", "Compound_47_vs_NIP228_A549_24hrs")]
rep = pd.DataFrame([dict(a=a, b=b, r_logFC=round(np.corrcoef(W[a], W[b])[0, 1], 3), overlap_FDR05=int(((P[a] < .05) & (P[b] < .05)).sum())) for a, b in pairs])
t3.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/tx_T3_antibody_alone.csv", index=False); rep.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/tx_T3b_antibody_alone_replication.csv", index=False)

# ---------------- T4: standard-error artefact of the pooled model
se6 = (W[IL[6]] / T[IL[6]]).abs()
art = pd.DataFrame({"symbol": ann.sym.reindex(W.index), "AveExpr_all114": AE.reindex(W.index),
                    "IL33_vs_vehicle_6h_logFC": W[IL[6]], "IL33_6h_adjP": P[IL[6]], "implied_SE": se6, "SE_percentile": se6.rank(pct=True),
                    "AX1177_vs_isotype_6h_logFC (independent arms)": W[AB[("HUVEC", 6)]], "AX1177_6h_adjP": P[AB[("HUVEC", 6)]],
                    "HGMEC_AX1177_vs_isotype_6h_logFC": W[AB[("HGMEC", 6)]]})
t4 = art[(art.IL33_vs_vehicle_6h_logFC.abs() >= 2) & (art.SE_percentile > .99)].sort_values("IL33_vs_vehicle_6h_logFC", ascending=False)
t4.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/tx_T4_SE_artefact_genes.csv")

# ---------------- T5: key genes panel
key = ["IL1RL1", "IL1RAP", "IL33", "SELE", "VCAM1", "ICAM1", "CXCL8", "CCL2", "CXCL1", "IL6", "CCL20", "CSF2", "CSF3", "CXCL10", "CX3CL1", "TNF",
       "TNFRSF9", "TNFRSF11B", "IL18R1", "CSF1", "IL1B", "PTX3", "F3", "SERPINE1", "PLAU", "THBD", "NOS3", "HGF", "VWF", "ANGPT2", "MX1", "ISG15"]
cols = {"IL33 vs veh 6h": IL[6], "IL33 vs veh 24h": IL[24], "AX vs iso HUVEC 6h": AB[("HUVEC", 6)], "AX vs iso HUVEC 24h": AB[("HUVEC", 24)],
        "AX vs iso HGMEC 6h": AB[("HGMEC", 6)], "AX vs iso HGMEC 24h": AB[("HGMEC", 24)]}
rows = []
for g in key:
    e = ann.index[ann.sym == g]
    if len(e) == 0: rows.append({"gene": g, "note": "not in delivered gene set"}); continue
    e = e[0]; r = {"gene": g, "AveExpr_all114": round(AE[e], 2), "SE_pct_IL33_6h": round(se6.rank(pct=True)[e], 3)}
    for k, c in cols.items(): r[k] = f"{W.loc[e, c]:+.2f}{'*' if P.loc[e, c] < .05 else ''}"
    rows.append(r)
t5 = pd.DataFrame(rows); t5.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/tx_T5_key_genes.csv", index=False)

# ---------------- IL-33 axis gene sets (used by serum bridge)
def tiers(tp):
    il, ab = IL[tp], AB[("HUVEC", tp)]
    se = (W[il] / T[il]).abs(); hi = se > se.quantile(.99)
    A = (W[il] >= 1) & (P[il] < .05) & (W[ab] <= -1) & (P[ab] < .05)
    B = (W[il] >= 1) & (W[ab] <= -1) & hi & ~A
    return A, B
A6, B6 = tiers(6); A24, B24 = tiers(24)
axis = pd.DataFrame({"tierA": A6 | A24, "tierB": (B6 | B24) & ~(A6 | A24)})
axis["symbol"] = ann.sym.reindex(axis.index)
axis.to_csv(f"{CACHE}/il33_axis_genes.csv")
print("IL-33 axis tier A:", int(axis.tierA.sum()), " tier B:", int(axis.tierB.sum()))

# ---------------- Figures
def label_pts(ax, x, y, genes, color="k"):
    for g in genes:
        e = ann.index[ann.sym == g]
        if len(e) and e[0] in x.index:
            ax.annotate(g, (x[e[0]], y[e[0]]), fontsize=7, color=color, xytext=(3, 3), textcoords="offset points")

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4.8))
for ax, (cl, tp) in zip(axs, [("HUVEC", 6), ("HUVEC", 24), ("HGMEC", 6)]):
    x, y = W[IL[tp]], W[AB[(cl, tp)]]
    sig = P[IL[tp]] < .05
    ax.scatter(x[~sig], y[~sig], s=2, c="#cccccc", rasterized=True, label="not IL-33-responsive")
    both = sig & (P[AB[(cl, tp)]] < .05)
    ax.scatter(x[sig & ~both], y[sig & ~both], s=3, c="#9ecae1", rasterized=True, label="IL-33 DEG")
    ax.scatter(x[both], y[both], s=3, c="#08519c", rasterized=True, label="IL-33 DEG reversed (FDR<0.05)")
    art_idx = t4.index
    ax.scatter(x[art_idx], y[art_idx], s=14, facecolors="none", edgecolors="#d62728", label="SE-artefact genes (n.s. in delivery)")
    lim = [-12, 13]; ax.plot(lim, [-v for v in lim], "k--", lw=.8); ax.axhline(0, c="k", lw=.4); ax.axvline(0, c="k", lw=.4)
    ax.set_xlim(lim); ax.set_ylim(-13, 8)
    r = np.corrcoef(x[sig], y[sig])[0, 1]
    ax.set_title(f"{cl} {tp} h: r = {r:+.2f} on {sig.sum()} HUVEC IL-33 DEGs", fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel(f"IL-33red vs vehicle, HUVEC {tp} h (log2FC)")
    ax.set_ylabel(f"AX-1177 + IL-33 vs isotype + IL-33, {cl} {tp} h (log2FC)")
    label_pts(ax, x, y, ["SELE", "VCAM1", "CXCL8", "CSF2", "CCL20", "IL6", "IL1RL1", "PTX3", "ICAM1", "NFKBIA"])
axs[0].legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower left")
fig.suptitle("Fig. 1  AX-1177 neutralises the IL-33red endothelial programme (dashed line = complete reversal)", fontsize=11)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/figures/Fig1_reversal_scatter.png", dpi=200); plt.close(fig)

# Fig 2: kinetics
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
labels = ["HUVEC IL-33 vs vehicle", "HUVEC AX-1177 vs isotype (+IL-33)", "HGMEC AX-1177 vs isotype (+IL-33)"]
v6 = [int((P[IL[6]] < .05).sum()), int((P[AB[("HUVEC", 6)]] < .05).sum()), int((P[AB[("HGMEC", 6)]] < .05).sum())]
v24 = [int((P[IL[24]] < .05).sum()), int((P[AB[("HUVEC", 24)]] < .05).sum()), int((P[AB[("HGMEC", 24)]] < .05).sum())]
xx = np.arange(3); ax.bar(xx - .2, v6, .4, label="6 h", color="#08519c"); ax.bar(xx + .2, v24, .4, label="24 h", color="#9ecae1")
for i in range(3):
    ax.text(xx[i] - .2, v6[i] + 50, str(v6[i]), ha="center", fontsize=8); ax.text(xx[i] + .2, v24[i] + 50, str(v24[i]), ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(xx); ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8); ax.set_ylabel("genes at FDR < 0.05"); ax.legend()
ax.set_title("Fig. 2  IL-33-driven endothelial activation is early and wanes by 24 h", fontsize=10)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/figures/Fig2_kinetics.png", dpi=200); plt.close(fig)

print(t2.to_string()); print(t3.to_string()); print(rep.to_string()); print(t4.head(12).round(3).to_string())

"""
AX-1177 audit -- step 4: clinical serum proteomics (n=100 hospitalised COVID-19; composite ICU/IMV/death at 30 d).
Requires steps 01-03.  Run: micromamba run -n singlecell python 04_serum.py
"""
import os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

CACHE = os.environ.get("AX_CACHE", "/tmp/work/cache"); OUT = os.environ.get("AX_OUT", "/tmp/outputs")
s = pd.read_pickle(f"{CACHE}/serum.pkl")
W = pd.read_parquet(f"{CACHE}/W.parquet"); P = pd.read_parquet(f"{CACHE}/P.parquet")
ann = pd.read_csv(f"{CACHE}/ann_checked.csv").set_index("ensembl"); ann["sym"] = ann.SYMBOL.fillna(ann.symbol)
axis = pd.read_csv(f"{CACHE}/il33_axis_genes.csv").set_index("ensembl")
go = pd.read_csv(f"{CACHE}/serum_go_loc.csv").drop_duplicates("gene").set_index("gene")

# ---- map serum gene symbols to Ensembl via corrected annotation
s2e = {}
for e, r in ann.iterrows():
    for sym in [r.sym, r.symbol]:
        if isinstance(sym, str) and sym not in s2e: s2e[sym] = e
s["ensembl"] = s.gene.map(s2e)
s["z"] = np.log(s.OR) / s.se
s["panel_short"] = s.panel.str.replace("Olink Target 96 ", "").str.replace(r"\(v\.\d+\)", "", regex=True)

# ---- S1: one row per unique protein; BH recomputed over the delivered set (best- and worst-case duplicate choice)
out = {}
for label, asc in [("best", True), ("worst", False)]:
    u = s.sort_values("p.value", ascending=asc).drop_duplicates("base").copy()
    u["BH_unique_delivered"] = multipletests(u["p.value"], method="fdr_bh")[1]
    out[label] = u.sort_values("p.value")
u = out["best"].copy()
u["rank_unique"] = np.arange(1, len(u) + 1)
u["n_panels"] = u.base.map(s.base.value_counts())
u = u.join(go[["extracellular_region", "cell_surface", "plasma_membrane"]], on="gene")
u["intracellular_only"] = ~(u.extracellular_region.fillna(False).astype(bool) | u.cell_surface.fillna(False).astype(bool) | u.plasma_membrane.fillna(False).astype(bool))
u["prognostic_FDR05"] = (u["adj.p.value"] < .05) & (u.OR > 1)
u["bonferroni_1194"] = u["p.value"] < .05 / 1194
u = u.join(axis[["tierA", "tierB"]], on="ensembl")
u["il33_axis"] = u.tierA.fillna(False).astype(bool) | u.tierB.fillna(False).astype(bool)
for c, lab in [("IL33_vs_Nontreated_HUVEC_6_hrs", "IL33_6h_lfc"), ("Compound_47_IL33_vs_IL33_NIP228_HUVEC_6hrs", "AX_vs_iso_6h_lfc"),
               ("IL33_vs_Nontreated_HUVEC_24_hrs", "IL33_24h_lfc"), ("Compound_47_IL33_vs_IL33_NIP228_HUVEC_24hrs", "AX_vs_iso_24h_lfc"),
               ("Compound_47_IL33_vs_IL33_NIP228_HGMEC_6hrs", "HGMEC_AX_vs_iso_6h_lfc")]:
    u[lab] = u.ensembl.map(W[c])
keep = ["rank_unique", "base", "gene", "panel_short", "n_panels", "OR", "l95", "u95", "p.value", "adj.p.value", "BH_unique_delivered",
        "bonferroni_1194", "prognostic_FDR05", "intracellular_only", "il33_axis", "tierA", "IL33_6h_lfc", "AX_vs_iso_6h_lfc",
        "IL33_24h_lfc", "AX_vs_iso_24h_lfc", "HGMEC_AX_vs_iso_6h_lfc", "composite_endpoint_0", "composite_endpoint_1"]
u[keep].to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/serum_S1_unique_proteins.csv", index=False)
summ = dict(delivered_rows=len(s), unique_proteins=int(s.base.nunique()), rows_reported_FDR05=int((s["adj.p.value"] < .05).sum()),
            unique_reported_FDR05=int(u.prognostic_FDR05.sum() + ((u["adj.p.value"] < .05) & (u.OR < 1)).sum()),
            unique_BH_delivered_best=int((out["best"].BH_unique_delivered < .05).sum()), unique_BH_delivered_worst=int((out["worst"].BH_unique_delivered < .05).sum()),
            OR_gt1_all=int((s.OR > 1).sum()), bonferroni=u.loc[u.bonferroni_1194, "base"].tolist())
print(summ)

# ---- S2: enrichment tests
def fisher(df, row, col):
    ct = pd.crosstab(df[row], df[col]).reindex(index=[False, True], columns=[False, True], fill_value=0)
    o, p = stats.fisher_exact(ct.values)
    return dict(n_in=int(ct.loc[True].sum()), hits_in=int(ct.loc[True, True]), rate_in=round(ct.loc[True, True] / max(1, ct.loc[True].sum()), 3),
                n_out=int(ct.loc[False].sum()), hits_out=int(ct.loc[False, True]), rate_out=round(ct.loc[False, True] / ct.loc[False].sum(), 3),
                fisher_OR=round(o, 2), p=float(f"{p:.3g}"))
mapped = u[u.ensembl.notna()].copy()
extra = mapped[~mapped.intracellular_only]
rows = [dict(test="IL-33/AX-1177 endothelial axis (tier A+B) vs other mapped proteins", **fisher(mapped, "il33_axis", "prognostic_FDR05")),
        dict(test="IL-33 axis tier A only vs other mapped proteins", **fisher(mapped.assign(tA=mapped.tierA.fillna(False).astype(bool)), "tA", "prognostic_FDR05")),
        dict(test="IL-33 axis vs other, extracellular/membrane proteins only", **fisher(extra, "il33_axis", "prognostic_FDR05")),
        dict(test="Intracellular-only (no extracellular/surface/membrane GO) vs other, all unique proteins", **fisher(u, "intracellular_only", "prognostic_FDR05"))]
strong = mapped[(mapped.IL33_6h_lfc >= 4) & (mapped.AX_vs_iso_6h_lfc <= -4)]
rows.append(dict(test="Strongly induced (>=16x) and reversed (<=1/16) at 6 h: number prognostic", n_in=len(strong), hits_in=int(strong.prognostic_FDR05.sum())))
s2 = pd.DataFrame(rows); s2.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/serum_S2_enrichment_tests.csv", index=False); print(s2.to_string())

# ---- S3: candidate biomarker table
cands = {"ST2": "IL-33 decoy receptor (sST2)", "HGF": "HGF", "IL6": "IL-6", "PTX3": "PTX3", "OPG": "OPG (TNFRSF11B)", "CCL20": "CCL20",
         "IL-18R1": "IL-18R1", "MCP-3": "MCP-3 (CCL7)", "IL8": "IL-8 (CXCL8)", "CSF-1": "CSF-1", "IL1B": "IL-1beta", "SELE": "E-selectin",
         "VCAM1": "VCAM-1", "ICAM1": "ICAM-1", "CXCL10": "CXCL10", "G-CSF": "G-CSF (CSF3)", "TF": "Tissue factor", "vWF": "vWF",
         "ANGPT2": "Angiopoietin-2", "MCP-1": "MCP-1 (CCL2)", "PAI": "PAI-1", "TNFRSF9": "TNFRSF9", "CX3CL1": "CX3CL1", "RAGE": "RAGE (sRAGE)",
         "IL5": "IL-5", "CCL11": "Eotaxin (CCL11)", "CCL17": "CCL17", "IL-5R-alpha": "IL-5Ralpha", "KIM1": "KIM-1", "NT-proBNP": "NT-proBNP"}
s3 = u[u.base.isin(cands)].copy(); s3["marker"] = s3.base.map(cands)
s3 = s3[["marker", "base", "panel_short", "n_panels", "OR", "l95", "u95", "p.value", "adj.p.value", "rank_unique", "IL33_6h_lfc", "AX_vs_iso_6h_lfc", "HGMEC_AX_vs_iso_6h_lfc"]]
s3.sort_values("p.value").to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/serum_S3_candidate_markers.csv", index=False)

# ---- Figure 3: serum landscape + enrichment
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.2), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1.6, 1]})
ax = axs[0]
x = np.log2(u.OR); y = -np.log10(u["p.value"])
cat = np.where(u.il33_axis, "IL-33/AX-1177 endothelial axis", np.where(u.intracellular_only, "intracellular-only protein", "other"))
colors = {"other": "#bdbdbd", "intracellular-only protein": "#fd8d3c", "IL-33/AX-1177 endothelial axis": "#08519c"}
for k in ["other", "intracellular-only protein", "IL-33/AX-1177 endothelial axis"]:
    m = cat == k; ax.scatter(x[m], y[m], s=12 if k != "other" else 6, c=colors[k], label=f"{k} (n={m.sum()})", alpha=.9)
thr = u.loc[u["adj.p.value"] < .05, "p.value"].max()
ax.axhline(-np.log10(thr), ls="--", c="k", lw=.7); ax.text(x.min(), -np.log10(thr) + .05, "reported FDR 0.05", fontsize=7)
for g in ["ST2", "HGF", "IL6", "PTX3", "OPG", "CCL20", "IL8", "SELE", "VCAM1", "ICAM1", "CXCL10", "CALR", "GSTP1", "SEMA4C", "G-CSF", "vWF"]:
    r = u[u.base == g]
    if len(r): ax.annotate(g if g != "ST2" else "sST2", (np.log2(r.OR.iloc[0]), -np.log10(r["p.value"].iloc[0])), fontsize=7, xytext=(3, 2), textcoords="offset points")
ax.set_xlabel("log2 OR per log unit (composite ICU/IMV/death, adj. age, sex, NEWS2)"); ax.set_ylabel("-log10 p")
ax.set_title("Serum proteins vs 30-day outcome (one row per unique protein)", fontsize=10); ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper left")
ax = axs[1]
labs = ["IL-33/AX-1177\nendothelial axis", "all other\nmapped proteins", "intracellular-\nonly proteins", "all other\nproteins"]
r1 = s2.iloc[0]; r4 = s2.iloc[3]
vals = [r1.rate_in, r1.rate_out, r4.rate_in, r4.rate_out]; ns = [f"{r1.hits_in}/{r1.n_in}", f"{r1.hits_out}/{r1.n_out}", f"{r4.hits_in}/{r4.n_in}", f"{r4.hits_out}/{r4.n_out}"]
bars = ax.bar(range(4), [100 * v for v in vals], color=["#08519c", "#bdbdbd", "#fd8d3c", "#bdbdbd"])
for i, (v, n) in enumerate(zip(vals, ns)): ax.text(i, 100 * v + .8, n, ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(labs, fontsize=8); ax.set_ylabel("% prognostic (FDR<0.05, OR>1)")
ax.text(.5, 36, f"Fisher OR {r1.fisher_OR}, p={r1.p}", ha="center", fontsize=8); ax.text(2.5, 36, f"Fisher OR {r4.fisher_OR}, p={r4.p:.1e}", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0, 40); ax.set_title("What the outcome signal is made of", fontsize=10)
fig.suptitle("Fig. 3  The serum outcome signal is not enriched for the IL-33 endothelial programme; it is enriched for intracellular (leakage) proteins", fontsize=10)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/figures/Fig3_serum_landscape.png", dpi=200); plt.close(fig)

# ---- Figure 4: forest plot of candidate markers (OR per log unit) with in-vitro behaviour
f = s3.sort_values("p.value").head(24).iloc[::-1]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 7))
yy = np.arange(len(f))
ax.errorbar(np.log2(f.OR), yy, xerr=[np.log2(f.OR) - np.log2(f.l95), np.log2(f.u95) - np.log2(f.OR)], fmt="o", c="k", ms=4, lw=1)
ax.axvline(0, c="grey", lw=.8)
lab = [f"{m}  [IL-33 {a:+.1f} / AX {b:+.1f}]" if pd.notna(a) else f"{m}  [not expressed/measured in vitro]" for m, a, b in zip(f.marker, f.IL33_6h_lfc, f.AX_vs_iso_6h_lfc)]
ax.set_yticks(yy); ax.set_yticklabels(lab, fontsize=8)
for yi, q in zip(yy, f["adj.p.value"]): ax.text(ax.get_xlim()[1] if False else 7.2, yi, f"FDR {q:.3f}", va="center", fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(-3, 8.5); ax.set_xlabel("log2 OR (95% CI) per log unit, composite endpoint")
ax.set_title("Fig. 4  Candidate markers: outcome association (serum) and in vitro behaviour\n[HUVEC 6 h log2FC: IL-33red vs vehicle / AX-1177 vs isotype]", fontsize=9)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/figures/Fig4_candidate_markers_forest.png", dpi=200); plt.close(fig)
pd.Series(summ).to_json(f"{OUT}/tables/serum_summary.json")

"""
AX-1177 audit -- step 5: post-mortem lung IHC (31 donors, 74 blocks).  Donor is the unit of analysis.
Requires step 01.  Run: micromamba run -n singlecell python 05_postmortem_ihc.py
"""
import os, re, warnings
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
CACHE = os.environ.get("AX_CACHE", "/tmp/work/cache"); OUT = os.environ.get("AX_OUT", "/tmp/outputs")
b = pd.read_pickle(f"{CACHE}/ihc_blocks.pkl")
M = {"IL33_epi": "IL-33 basal epithelium", "IL33_endo": "IL-33 endothelium", "IL33_vsm": "IL-33 vascular smooth muscle",
     "EPX_s": "EPX (eosinophil)", "EDN_s": "EDN (eosinophil)", "MBP_s": "MBP (eosinophil)", "2D7_s": "2D7 (basophil)",
     "IL5Ra_NEdup_s": "IL-5Ra (NE duplex)", "NE_s": "Neutrophil elastase", "IL5Ra_TRYdup_s": "IL-5Ra (tryptase duplex)", "TRY_s": "Tryptase (mast cell)"}
don = b.groupby(["ID", "group"])[list(M)].mean().reset_index()
meta = b.drop_duplicates("ID").set_index("ID")
don["Age"] = don.ID.map(meta.Age).astype(float); don["Sex"] = don.ID.map(meta.Sex); don["Notes"] = don.ID.map(meta.Notes)
don["n_blocks"] = don.ID.map(b.groupby("ID").size()); don["RNA_available"] = don.ID.map(b.groupby("ID").RNA.apply(lambda s: s.notna().any()))
pat = r"pneumoni|pneumonitis|alveolar damage|lung injury|coccidioid|aspergill"
don["lung_inflammation_in_autopsy_text"] = don.ID.map(meta.Path.astype(str).str.contains(pat, case=False, regex=True))
don["covid"] = (don.group == "COVID+ pneumonia").astype(int)
don.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/ihc_P1_donor_level_scores.csv", index=False)

order = ["COVID- non-pneumonia", "COVID- pneumonia", "COVID+ pneumonia"]
rows = []
for m, lab in M.items():
    r = {"marker": lab}
    for g in order:
        v = don.loc[don.group == g, m].dropna(); r[f"{g} median [IQR] (n)"] = f"{v.median():.2f} [{v.quantile(.25):.2f}-{v.quantile(.75):.2f}] ({len(v)})"
    cp, cn, nn = [don.loc[don.group == g, m].dropna() for g in ["COVID+ pneumonia", "COVID- pneumonia", "COVID- non-pneumonia"]]
    r["p COVID+ vs COVID- pneumonia (donor)"] = round(stats.mannwhitneyu(cp, cn).pvalue, 4)
    bp, bn = [b.loc[b.group == g, m].dropna() for g in ["COVID+ pneumonia", "COVID- pneumonia"]]
    r["p same, BLOCK-level (pseudo-replicated)"] = round(stats.mannwhitneyu(bp, bn).pvalue, 4)
    r["p pneumonia vs non-pneumonia as labelled (donor)"] = round(stats.mannwhitneyu(pd.concat([cp, cn]), nn).pvalue, 4)
    y = don.loc[don.lung_inflammation_in_autopsy_text, m].dropna(); n = don.loc[~don.lung_inflammation_in_autopsy_text, m].dropna()
    r["p lung inflammation per autopsy text yes vs no (donor)"] = round(stats.mannwhitneyu(y, n).pvalue, 4)
    x = don[[m, "Age"]].dropna(); rho, pr = stats.spearmanr(x[m], x.Age); r["Spearman rho vs age (p)"] = f"{rho:+.2f} ({pr:.3f})"
    if m.startswith("IL33"):
        d = don[[m, "covid", "Age", "lung_inflammation_in_autopsy_text"]].dropna().copy(); d["rk"] = d[m].rank()
        fit = smf.ols("rk ~ covid + Age + lung_inflammation_in_autopsy_text", data=d).fit()
        r["age/inflammation-adjusted COVID p (rank OLS)"] = round(fit.pvalues["covid"], 3)
    rows.append(r)
p2 = pd.DataFrame(rows); p2.to_csv(f"{OUT}/tables/ihc_P2_group_comparisons.csv", index=False)
print(p2.to_string())
within = {m: b.groupby("ID")[m].agg(lambda s: s.max() - s.min() if s.notna().sum() > 1 else np.nan).dropna() for m in ["IL33_epi", "IL33_endo", "IL33_vsm"]}
print({m: (round(v.median(), 2), round(v.max(), 2)) for m, v in within.items()})

# Figure 5: donor-level dot plots

show = ["IL33_epi", "IL33_endo", "IL33_vsm", "NE_s", "IL5Ra_NEdup_s"]
cols = {"COVID- non-pneumonia": "#74c476", "COVID- pneumonia": "#fd8d3c", "COVID+ pneumonia": "#de2d26"}
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
for ax, m in zip(axs, show):
    for i, g in enumerate(order):

# AX-1177 (anti-IL-33 IgG1; research code Compound_47) — portfolio-audit position

**For:** Respiratory portfolio audit committee  **Scope:** viral lower-respiratory-tract disease (LRTD) programme
**Evidence base:** only our four delivered datasets (mmc2–mmc5) and the Methods Annex, taken as ground truth. Every number below is regenerated from the raw files by `code/run_all.sh`; supporting tables are in `AX-1177_evidence_tables.xlsx`; figures are in `figures/`.

---

## 1. Recommendation

**Do not keep AX-1177 in the portfolio as a viral-LRTD asset. Stop LRTD-directed development spend now.**

**What happens to the molecule:** by default it is terminated after a close-out review of up to 12 weeks. That review runs no new experiments. It only retrieves and re-analyses data we already hold:
- the 100 serum assays analysed but left out of the delivery, which may include IL-33 itself;
- the archived RNA-seq count matrices;
- the 22 post-mortem lung RNA samples.

Termination is reversed only if the pre-set criteria in §6.6 are met.

**Why, in one sentence:** our data show clearly that AX-1177 neutralises IL-33 in cultured endothelium. They do not show that IL-33 is active in, or drives, viral LRTD:
- the target was never quantified in patients;
- IL-33 in lung tissue is the same in COVID-19 as in controls;
- the IL-33-driven programme the antibody blocks is not what predicts poor outcome.

| What an LRTD programme needs to be true | Our data | Key numbers |
|---|---|---|
| **1.** AX-1177 neutralises IL-33 signalling | **Supported (strong)** | IL-33red changes 4,031 HUVEC genes at 6 h. AX-1177 reverses 2,884 of them against the isotype arm (r = −0.80), leaving a median ~4% of the response. The same programme is blocked in glomerular microvascular cells. No reproducible effect of the antibody alone in 4 cell types. |
| **2.** IL-33 is released and active in the patients | **Not shown** | IL-33 is absent from the serum delivery, although it is on the Olink Inflammation panel; 100 analysed assays were omitted. Lung IL-33 staining does not differ between COVID-19 and non-COVID pneumonia (donor-level p = 0.92 / 0.16 / 0.15 for epithelium / endothelium / smooth muscle). |
| **3.** IL-33-driven biology tracks clinical outcome | **Not shown** | Proteins of the IL-33/AX-1177 programme predict ICU/ventilation/death no more often than other proteins (20.5% vs 16.9%; p = 0.43). The most endothelium-specific ones (VCAM-1, ICAM-1, E-selectin) do not predict at all. Intracellular "leakage" proteins do (28.6% vs 13.6%; p = 1.5×10⁻⁵). |
| Scope: "viral LRTD" | **Only COVID-19** | All human data are from SARS-CoV-2: 100 patients, pre-vaccination, single centre. There are no influenza, RSV or other viral data. |

**The best pro-asset fact, kept on the record:** soluble ST2 (sST2, the IL-33 decoy receptor) is the **#2 predictor of poor outcome out of 1,063 proteins**. Odds ratio (OR) 3.02 per log unit, 95% CI 1.83–5.01, FDR 0.0075; it is one of only two proteins surviving Bonferroni correction. This is why I recommend a short close-out rather than immediate termination. But sST2 is not IL-33-specific, and it cannot carry a programme on its own.

---

## 2. What each dataset shows

### 2.1 In vitro transcriptomics (mmc4/mmc5): the pharmacology is clean

![Fig 1](figures/Fig1_reversal_scatter.png)

**IL-33red triggers a strong endothelial activation programme in HUVEC** (IL-33red = reduced IL-33, 30 ng/mL):
- 4,031 genes change at 6 h and 1,836 at 24 h (FDR < 0.05).
- Enriched pathways (Hallmark normalised enrichment scores): TNFα/NF-κB 3.17, IFN-γ 2.84, inflammatory response 2.74, IFN-α 2.73, IL-6/JAK/STAT3 2.64, complement 2.26, coagulation 1.60.
- Adhesion molecules: E-selectin (SELE) +11.2 log2FC, VCAM-1 +8.7, ICAM-1 +6.0.
- Chemokines and cytokines: CCL20 +9.2, CXCL8 +8.2, CSF2 +10.3, TNF +7.9, IL6 +5.8.
- Pro-coagulant shift: tissue factor (F3) +5.6, PAI-1 +1.7, thrombomodulin −1.0.

**AX-1177 reverses the programme** (10 µg/mL, a ~41-fold molar excess, added at the same time as IL-33):
- The clean comparison is AX-1177 + IL-33 vs isotype + IL-33, because these arms share nothing with the IL-33-vs-vehicle contrast.
- At 6 h: r = −0.80; 2,884 of 4,031 genes significantly reversed, 12 moved the same way; residual IL-33 response about 4% (median).
- At 24 h: r = −0.65; 694 of 1,836 reversed; residual about 9%.
- The delivered "AX-1177 + IL-33 vs IL-33" contrast shares the IL-33 arm and inflates apparent reversal (r = −0.93). At 24 h the isotype arm itself shows only 77% of the IL-33 response, so only isotype-controlled contrasts should be quoted.

**Glomerular microvascular endothelium (HGMEC):** at 6 h, 942 of 964 shared genes are reversed (r = −0.66). There is no HGMEC vehicle arm and no HGMEC IL-33-vs-control contrast was delivered, so the HGMEC IL-33 response is *inferred*, not measured.

**Timing:** the response is early and transient (Fig. 2).
- HUVEC: 4,031 → 1,836 genes from 6 h to 24 h.
- HGMEC, antibody-reversible genes: 1,460 → 269.

**Specificity of the antibody alone:** 16 contrasts (vs isotype, PBS and DMSO) in 4 cell types give 14–73 "significant" genes each. Of these, 82–100% are statistical artefacts, either:
- trivial shifts in highly expressed genes (e.g., AKR1C2 log2FC 0.11 at FDR 10⁻⁹⁴), or
- noisy changes in barely expressed transcripts.

None replicates across timepoint or cell line (r ≈ 0), none correlates with the IL-33 programme (|r| ≤ 0.09), and the NF-κB sentinels (NFKBIA, TNFAIP3) are flat. So there is no sign of agonism or endotoxin-like contamination. Pathway-level proliferation and metabolism shifts flip sign depending on which control arm is used, which points to culture-state noise. A modest, consistent shift in HGMEC should be rechecked in multi-donor work.

**Not addressed by these experiments:**
- epithelium (A549 and MCF7 never received IL-33);
- oxidised IL-33;
- potency (one concentration only);
- adding the antibody *after* IL-33;
- donor variation (one donor per primary cell type, at different passages).

### 2.2 Clinical serum proteomics (mmc2): a severity signal, not an IL-33 signal

![Fig 3](figures/Fig3_serum_landscape.png)

**Cohort:** 100 patients hospitalised with COVID-19; 44 met the composite endpoint (ICU, invasive ventilation or death within 30 days). Models are adjusted for age, sex and NEWS2.

**The outcome signal is broad:**
- 893 of 1,094 ORs are above 1; 169 unique proteins are significant at FDR < 0.05.
- Top hits: HGF, sST2, HDGF, SEMA4C, PTX3, ANXA1, CLEC5A, NPM1, IL-6 (OR 2.1–2.3 on all four panels that measure it).

**The IL-33 endothelial programme is not enriched among outcome proteins:**
- Overall: OR 1.26, p = 0.43. Restricted to extracellular/membrane proteins: OR 1.54, p = 0.17.
- Of the 20 products most strongly induced by IL-33 and reversed by AX-1177 (≥16-fold), **4 are prognostic** (IL-6, OPG, CCL20, IL-8).
- **16 are not**, including VCAM-1 (FDR 0.61), ICAM-1 (0.25), E-selectin (0.09), G-CSF (0.40) and CXCL10 (0.42).

**Intracellular-only proteins are 2.5× enriched** among outcome hits (e.g., CALR, GSTP1, PRDX1/6, NPM1, CASP8). That is consistent with cell injury and/or ex-vivo release into clotted serum.

**Other axes are null:**
- Type-2/eosinophil: IL-5 OR 1.00 (p = 0.997), eotaxin p = 0.84, CCL17 p = 0.39.
- Kidney and cardiac markers: KIM-1 (FDR 0.11) and NT-proBNP (FDR 0.15) are not significant.

### 2.3 Post-mortem lung immunohistochemistry (mmc3): IL-33 is everywhere and not different in COVID-19

![Fig 5](figures/Fig5_postmortem_donor_level.png)

**Material:** 31 donors (16 COVID+, 10 COVID− "pneumonia", 5 COVID− "non-pneumonia"); 74 blocks; ages 64–98; one reader. The donor is the unit of analysis.

**IL-33 is high in all groups.** The endothelial score sits at the ceiling (5.5) in 39 of 74 blocks.

**No COVID-specific difference.** Comparing COVID+ with COVID− pneumonia:
- basal epithelium p = 0.92, endothelium p = 0.16, vascular smooth muscle p = 0.15 (COVID+ trends lower);
- no effect after adjusting for age.

**Age confounds the scores.** Endothelial and smooth-muscle IL-33 rise with age (ρ ≈ +0.55, p = 0.001).

**Inflammatory cells mark pneumonia, not COVID-19.** Neutrophil elastase, IL-5Rα⁺ cells and eosinophil granule proteins separate pneumonia from non-pneumonia (p = 0.005–0.009), with no difference between COVID+ and COVID− pneumonia (p ≥ 0.44).

**One hypothesis-only observation:** endothelial IL-33 is lower where the autopsy documents lung inflammation (4.88 vs 5.50; p = 0.008; n = 24 vs 7). This fits IL-33 being released during injury, but it is confounded by age, the score ceiling and mislabelled controls.

---

## 3. Audit findings on the data package

These limit how far any claim can go, whichever way the committee decides.

| # | Finding | Evidence | Consequence / fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **The serum FDR was computed over 1,194 tests, but only 1,094 assays were delivered.** The annex says "all assays in the delivery". | The back-calculated BH denominator is exactly 1,194 at the top ranks. At least one omitted assay ranked in the top ~20 associations (p ≈ 2–3×10⁻⁴), and ~4 omitted assays would pass FDR 0.05. **IL-33 is absent** from the delivery. | The target's own clinical data are missing, and the delivered FDRs cannot be reproduced (recomputing gives 206 vs 178 hits). **Retrieve the full output with QC/LOD flags.** |
| 2 | **Post-mortem group labels contradict the autopsy diagnoses.** | 4 of 10 "COVID− pneumonia" donors have no pneumonia (1905, 1961, 1968, 1970). 3 of 5 "non-pneumonia" donors have acute/organising pneumonia, pneumonitis or pulmonary coccidioidomycosis (1976, 1956, 1944). Donor 1905 has no SARS-CoV-2 result. | The comparator groups are unreliable. **Re-adjudicate from the autopsy reports.** |
| 3 | **The IL-33 scores are hidden and not fit for purpose.** | IL-33 columns X–Z are hidden. Scores are undocumented composites; one cell is a live formula `=(2+4.5)/2`. Values reach 5.5 on a stated 0–5 scale; 53% of endothelial scores are at the ceiling; one reader. | The stain cannot discriminate. **Blinded re-read by two readers plus quantitative image analysis; score nuclear vs extranuclear IL-33.** |
| 4 | **One pooled model was fitted across four cell types.** | Key endothelial genes have implied standard errors in the top 0.5%: E-selectin 8.9, CXCL1 1,155, vs a median of 0.34. They are reported "non-significant" despite ±8–11 log2FC mirrored in independent arms. Meanwhile trivial changes reach FDR 10⁻⁹⁴. | Gene-level p-values are unreliable, and key genes (SELE, VCAM1, CXCL8, CCL2, PTX3, IL1RL1) are false negatives. **Refit per cell line from the archived counts.** |
| 5 | **Design gaps in the in vitro work.** | No HGMEC vehicle arm or IL-33 contrast. Epithelial lines never received IL-33. One donor per primary cell type (HUVEC P2, HGMEC P5). One antibody concentration, added concurrently only. DMSO is not the antibody's vehicle. | Claims about potency, timing, epithelium or generalisability cannot be made. **See Stage 1 (§6.6).** |
| 6 | **Pseudo-replication in the post-mortem data.** | Three donors supply 24 of the 49 COVID+ blocks. Block-level testing produces false positives: IL-5Rα COVID+ vs COVID− pneumonia p = 0.025 by block vs 0.49 by donor. | **Analyse per donor** (done here). |
| 7 | **Cross-panel duplicates are counted as separate tests and hits.** | 27 proteins are measured on 2–4 panels (IL-6 ×4). The two hidden rows are duplicates (HGF, IL-6). | Apparent breadth is inflated. **Deduplicate** (done here: 1,063 unique proteins). |
| 8 | **Gene annotation is wrong for many genes.** | 1,129 named genes carry clone-ID placeholders (e.g., OAS1, LTBR, MCAM). 1,713 symbols disagree with org.Hs.eg.db; 8,550 genes lack Entrez IDs. | Symbol-based lookups silently drop genes. **Key on Ensembl ID** (done here). |
| 9 | **AveExpr is averaged over all 114 libraries.** | CSF2 −3.2, SELE −1.7, VCAM1 −1.7. | Filtering on AveExpr would delete the core IL-33 genes. **Do not filter on it.** |
| 10 | **The OR scale is ambiguous.** | ORs are "per log unit" after log-transforming Olink output, which is already on a log2 scale. | ORs cannot be compared across assays (e.g., CSF-1 OR 90, CI 4–1,933). **Re-express per SD.** |
| 11 | **Pre-analytical risk in clotted serum.** | Processing time is not documented; intracellular proteins are 2.5× enriched among outcome hits. | **Use EDTA plasma with a fixed processing SOP in future.** |
| 12 | **Minor file hygiene.** | mmc5's "6h" and "24h" sheets each contain all 24 contrasts (one padded with blank rows to Excel's row limit, one partly re-sorted; the values reconcile exactly). mmc4 says "Nontreated" where the annex says "Vehicle". Two undocumented per-group fraction columns in mmc2. Donor notes for 2040/2045 sit on non-first rows, against the annex rule. | Cosmetic, but **record it in the audit file.** |

---

## 4. Defence: likely challenges and answers

**"AX-1177 abolishes IL-33-driven endothelial activation — isn't that enough?"**
It proves the drug hits its target, and we accept that fully. It does not show that the target matters in disease; any competent neutralising antibody would produce Fig. 1. An LRTD programme needs links 2 and 3 as well, and our data do not supply them.

**"sST2 is the #2 outcome predictor — doesn't that prove the IL-33 pathway is active?"**
It is our best signal, and it is robust: Bonferroni-significant and ranked #2 however duplicates are handled. But:
- sST2 is released under many inflammatory stresses, and it is itself an endogenous IL-33 blocker, so high sST2 can equally mean IL-33 is already neutralised;
- without IL-33 data, which are absent from the delivery, activation cannot be told apart from non-specific stress.

That is exactly what the close-out review checks.

**"IL-6, CCL20, OPG, PTX3 and IL-8 are all IL-33-inducible in our cells, and they all predict outcome."**
Those five are a selective pick:
- across all 78 measured IL-33-programme proteins, the hit rate is no higher than chance (p = 0.43);
- the most endothelium-specific readouts of IL-33 activity (VCAM-1, ICAM-1, E-selectin) do not predict outcome;
- those five are generic NF-κB products.

**"IL-33 is an alarmin — tissue staining can't show its activity."**
Agreed, which is why the tissue cannot support the case either. At donor level there is no COVID-specific difference. The one trend (lower endothelial staining with inflammation) is confounded by age, the score ceiling and mislabelled controls.

**"Our plan targeted viral LRTD, and these are viral LRTD patients."**
They are COVID-19 only: pre-vaccination, one centre, n = 100. There are no influenza, RSV or other viral data, and the "COVID-negative pneumonia" tissue is mostly bronchopneumonia of unrecorded cause. Extrapolating to viral LRTD is not supported.

**"Why not terminate today?"**
Because the deciding data already sit in our archive (the omitted assays including IL-33, the count matrices, the 22 lung RNAs). The close-out costs analyst time, not experiments, and defaults to termination. If the committee wants zero further spend, immediate termination is defensible on the current evidence.

**"Is there a safety reason behind this?"**
No. AX-1177 showed no reproducible off-target transcriptional activity; the decision is about the efficacy rationale. One point for any viral indication: IL-33 induces interferon-stimulated genes in endothelium (Hallmark IFN-α +2.73) and AX-1177 blocks this, so viral clearance would need monitoring.

---

## 5. What we are dropping, and why

We are dropping a well-behaved IL-33 neutraliser from a programme whose central premise is unsupported by our own data. The premise is that IL-33 drives progression of viral LRTD. Against it:
- the target was never measured in patients;
- IL-33 in diseased lung is indistinguishable from controls;
- what predicts poor outcome in hospitalised COVID-19 is broad injury and inflammation, not the IL-33 endothelial programme the antibody blocks;
- the human evidence is COVID-only.

We are **not** dropping it for safety or developability reasons. Its in vitro selectivity is clean, and that package should be archived intact for any future IL-33 programme or partnering discussion.

---

## 6. Forward view

### 6.1 What indication our data actually point at

Our data point at **a mechanism and a patient state, not a pathogen**:
- **Mechanism:** IL-33-driven activation of vascular endothelium (large-vessel and microvascular): adhesion molecules, chemokines, and a pro-coagulant shift. This is the only biology AX-1177 has been shown to block.
- **Patient state:** hospitalised patients with severe pneumonia at risk of progression to ICU, ventilation or death. This is the only clinical population with data, and high sST2 identifies those at greatest risk.
- **Pathogen:** nothing in the tissue is COVID-specific. Whatever IL-33 biology exists is shared with non-COVID pneumonia.

So the best-supported hypothesis is **sST2-high, severe, hospitalised pneumonia with endothelial involvement, whatever the pathogen**. That is narrower than "viral LRTD", is defined by the host response rather than the virus, and is **untested**. It should not be funded until links 2 and 3 are shown.

The data do **not** point to COPD/asthma, kidney or cardiovascular disease (§7).

### 6.2 What the next studies have to establish, in order

1. **The target is present.** IL-33 is released and free in target patients' blood at the time we would treat, shown by measurable free IL-33 or an IL-33-specific activity readout.
2. **The mechanism is active in patients.** IL-33-dependent endothelial activation is present in patient blood or lung, separable from generic NF-κB activation, and tracks outcome independently of NEWS2 and IL-6.
3. **The signal generalises.** sST2's prognostic value replicates in a contemporary (vaccinated, current standard of care), multi-pathogen cohort, using plasma and an absolute assay. If it does not, the indication narrows to where it holds.
4. **The drug works therapeutically.** AX-1177 reverses *established* activation (dosed after IL-33), across donors, in lung microvascular endothelium and primary airway epithelium, and blocks oxidised IL-33, at a potency compatible with achievable exposure.
5. **A PD readout exists.** A pharmacodynamic marker set moves with IL-33 blockade and can be measured in plasma.

### 6.3 Biomarkers, and which can go into patients

![Fig 4](figures/Fig4_candidate_markers_forest.png)

| Marker | Our evidence | Role | Into patients? |
|---|---|---|---|
| **sST2** (soluble ST2) | #2 of 1,063 outcome proteins; OR 3.02 (1.83–5.01), FDR 0.0075. The IL1RL1 transcript is +1.6 with IL-33 and −1.7 with AX-1177 (an artefact-affected gene). | **Prognostic enrichment / stratification at baseline**; candidate PD marker | **Yes, now**, as an exploratory stratification or enrichment factor (not a selection claim), moving to an absolute assay in plasma |
| **Free and total (drug-bound) IL-33** | None: absent from the delivery | **Target engagement** (total rises, free falls after dosing); selection if detectable | **Not yet.** Retrieve the omitted data; qualify a sensitive, drug-tolerant assay |
| **sE-selectin** | Endothelium-specific. +11.2 with IL-33, −11.0 with AX-1177 (HUVEC), −8.7 in HGMEC. Serum p = 0.02 (FDR 0.09) | **PD** of endothelial IL-33 blockade | Exploratory PD, after the per-cell-line refit confirms it |
| **CCL20, OPG, IL-6** (+ IL-18R1, IL-8, CSF-1) | IL-33-induced and AX-reversed in HUVEC and HGMEC; prognostic (FDR 0.012–0.037) | **PD panel** ("IL-33 endothelial score"); IL-6 also a prognostic covariate | Exploratory PD. Not IL-33-specific (also induced by IL-1β/TNF) |
| **PTX3** | OR 11.6 per log unit, FDR 0.012. Transcript +2.2 / −2.3 (artefact-affected) | Prognostic; candidate PD | Exploratory |
| **HGF** | #1 outcome protein (Bonferroni-significant); not IL-33-regulated in endothelium | **Prognostic covariate only** | Yes as a covariate; never as PD |
| sVCAM-1, sICAM-1, CXCL10, G-CSF | Strongly IL-33-induced and AX-reversed; **not** prognostic | PD only | Exploratory PD; not for selection |
| Viral load / clearance | AX-1177 blocks IL-33-induced endothelial interferon-stimulated genes | **Safety** monitoring in any viral indication | Yes (standard) |
| *Ruled out:* intracellular serum proteins, tissue IL-33 IHC, IL-5/eotaxin/CCL17, NT-proBNP, KIM-1 | Leakage-type, non-discriminating, or null | Use intracellular proteins only as a sample-quality ("lysis") covariate | No |

No marker in our data predicts *response* to AX-1177, because no patient has been treated. Stratified randomisation by sST2-high vs sST2-low is how that would be tested.

### 6.4 Sampling timepoint

- **Primary: enrolment, before dosing (Day 0).** This is the only timepoint at which our serum associations exist. Record time from symptom onset and from admission; these are absent from our dataset.
- **PD: 24 h (±4 h) after dosing;** Day 3 secondary, Day 7 for durability; outcome at Day 30 (matching our composite).
- **Rationale:** in our cells, IL-33-driven activation peaks early (6 h) and fades by 24 h (HUVEC 4,031 → 1,836 genes; HGMEC 1,460 → 269). AX-1177 reversal is still clear at 24 h (r = −0.65). Secreted products need hours to accumulate, so 24 h is the earliest practical time to see suppression in blood. This is an extrapolation from transcripts to circulating proteins, to be confirmed in Stage 1/2.
- **In vitro follow-up:** 6 h primary (largest dynamic range; HGMEC is only informative at 6 h), 24 h secondary.
- **Specimen:** EDTA plasma with a fixed processing time, plus serum for bridging.

### 6.5 Plan and decision gates

**Stage 0: archive close-out (≤12 weeks; analyst and pathologist time; no new experiments). Default outcome: terminate.**
- a. Retrieve the complete 1,194-assay output, patient-level NPX and QC/LOD flags; locate IL-33.
- b. Patient-level re-analysis: does sST2 stay prognostic after adding IL-6, HGF and a lysis index to NEWS2? What is the discrimination gain?
- c. Refit the transcriptomics per cell line; add the HGMEC IL-33-vs-isotype contrast; confirm the artefact-affected genes.
- d. Score the IL-33 endothelial signature in the 22 existing lung RNA samples (9 COVID+, 9 COVID− pneumonia, 4 non-pneumonia); re-adjudicate group labels; blinded double re-read of IL-33 IHC.
- **Continue only if** sST2 stays independently prognostic (p < 0.01 after IL-6, HGF and lysis adjustment) **and** at least one of:
  - IL-33 is detectable in ≥50% of event patients, or associated with outcome;
  - the IL-33 endothelial signature is higher in inflamed than in non-inflamed lung (donor-level, age-adjusted).
- Otherwise terminate and archive.

**Stage 1: decisive in vitro package (~6 months).**
- AX-1177 added 1, 3 and 6 h *after* IL-33.
- IL-33 and antibody dose–response (IC50).
- Oxidised and full-length IL-33.
- Lung microvascular endothelium plus HUVEC/HGMEC from ≥3 donors; primary airway epithelium (air–liquid interface) stimulated with IL-33.
- IL-1β/TNF comparator arms, to define IL-33-specific secreted PD markers.
- Virus-infected epithelium–endothelium co-culture.
- **Go** if ≥50% inhibition is retained when AX-1177 is added ≥3 h after IL-33 at achievable concentrations, and an IL-33-specific PD set exists.

**Stage 2: prospective observational cohort (~12–18 months).**
- Hospitalised adults with LRTD of any cause (SARS-CoV-2, influenza, RSV, hMPV, bacterial community-acquired pneumonia).
- EDTA plasma at Day 0, 24 h, Day 3 and Day 7; free/total IL-33, sST2 and the PD panel; composite outcome at Day 30.
- **Go** to an sST2-enriched Phase 2a (PD at 24 h, target engagement by IL-33, viral-load safety) only if sST2 and/or IL-33 is independently prognostic in ≥2 causes and a pre-specified cut-off raises the event rate ≥1.5×.

---

## 7. Considered and ruled out

**Decision options**
- *Keep in viral LRTD as is:* ruled out. Two of the three required links are missing, and the human data are COVID-only.
- *Pivot now to an sST2-enriched severe-pneumonia trial:* ruled out as premature. There is no target-engagement marker, no validated PD marker and no multi-pathogen replication.
- *Terminate immediately without the close-out:* defensible, but it gives up a near-zero-cost answer that already exists in our archive. Acceptable if the committee wants zero spend.

**Alternative indications**
- *COVID-19 specifically:* ruled out. The tissue shows nothing COVID-specific, and the cohort is pre-vaccination.
- *COPD / asthma / type-2 airway disease:* not supported by our data.
  - We have no epithelial IL-33 experiments.
  - IL-33 staining does not differ by COPD/asthma history (p = 0.13–0.18, 12 vs 19 donors).
  - Serum type-2 markers are null.
- *Kidney (diabetic kidney disease / acute kidney injury), prompted by the HGMEC data:* ruled out for now. The HGMEC IL-33 response is inferred, from a single donor, and KIM-1 and cystatin C show no association.
- *Cardiovascular / heart failure, prompted by sST2:* ruled out. sST2 here tracks inflammatory severity, NT-proBNP is not associated, and there are no cardiac data.
- *Sepsis / ARDS broadly:* not ruled in. It is consistent with the pathogen-agnostic hypothesis, but we have no non-pneumonia data.

**Candidate biomarkers**
- *HGF as PD:* not IL-33-regulated.
- *Intracellular serum proteins:* leakage or pre-analytical artefacts.
- *Very large per-log-unit ORs* (CSF-1 90, GSTP1 24.6, CTSS 23.2): reflect narrow assay ranges, not effect size.
- *Tissue IL-33 IHC:* ceiling effect, single reader, no discrimination.
- *IL-5 / eotaxin / CCL17:* null.
- *VCAM-1 / ICAM-1 / G-CSF / CXCL10 as enrichment markers:* null in serum (acceptable as PD only).

**Analytical shortcuts rejected**
- Block-level IHC statistics (pseudo-replication).
- The shared-arm "AX-1177 + IL-33 vs IL-33" contrast as proof of reversal.
- Filtering genes on AveExpr.
- Symbol-based gene mapping.
- Trusting the delivered FDRs.
- Counting cross-panel duplicates as independent hits.
- Reading antibody-alone "DEGs" as off-target biology.

---

## 8. Limitations of this review

- **No patient-level proteomics.** I could not adjust sST2 for IL-6, HGF or lysis, nor estimate discrimination; the OR scale is as delivered.
- **No count matrices.** The transcript conclusions rest on the delivered log fold-changes and on concordance between independent arms, not on a refit.
- **Data not in the package:** in vivo efficacy, PK, toxicology, affinity and potency (held in the biologics file).
- **My own classifications:**
  - "Intracellular-only" uses GO annotation, which is imperfect.
  - "Lung inflammation" in the autopsy text was keyword-based; I read the discordant cases in full.
  - The omitted-assay reconstruction gives their number and p-value positions, not their identities.
- **Enrichment tests** depend on the Olink-to-gene mapping (915 of 1,063 proteins map to expressed transcripts).

2-space nested bullets -> 4-space (python-markdown convention).""" out, prev = [], "" for line in text.splitlines(): is_list = bool(re.match(r"^\s*(- |\d+\. )", line)) prev_list = bool(re.match(r"^\s*(- |\d+\. )", prev)) if is_list and prev.strip() and not prev_list: out.append("") if re.match(r"^ - ", line): line = " " + line[2:] out.append(line); prev = line return "\n".join(out) def render_html(): import markdown body = markdown.markdown(preprocess(md), extensions=["tables", "nl2br", "sane_lists"]) def embed(m): path = os.path.join(OUT, m.group(1)) data = base64.b64encode(open(path, "rb").read()).decode() return f'src="data:image/png;base64,{data}"' body = re.sub(r'src="(figures/[^"]+)"', embed, body) css = """body{font-family:'DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif;max-width:1100px;margin:30px auto;padding:0 24px;color:#1a1a1a;line-height:1.45;font-size:14px} h1{font-size:22px;border-bottom:3px solid #08519c;padding-bottom:6px}h2{font-size:18px;color:#08519c;margin-top:28px;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc} h3{font-size:15px;color:#333}table{border-collapse:collapse;margin:10px 0 16px;font-size:12.5px;width:100%} th,td{border:1px solid #bbb;padding:5px 7px;vertical-align:top;text-align:left}th{background:#e8eef6}tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#fafafa} img{max-width:100%;border:1px solid #ddd;margin:8px 0}code{background:#f2f2f2;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px}hr{border:0;border-top:1px solid #ccc;margin:22px 0}""" html = f"AX-1177 portfolio audit{body}" open(f"{OUT}/AX-1177_portfolio_audit_memo.html", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(html) print("HTML written") def render_pdf(): from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4 from reportlab.lib.units import mm from reportlab.lib import colors from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, Table, TableStyle, Image, ListFlowable, ListItem, HRFlowable from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont from reportlab.lib.fonts import addMapping F = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/" pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("DV", F + "DejaVuSans.ttf")); pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("DVB", F + "DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf")) pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("DVI", F + "DejaVuSans-Oblique.ttf")); pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("DVBI", F + "DejaVuSans-BoldOblique.ttf")) pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("DVM", F + "DejaVuSansMono.ttf")) addMapping("DV", 0, 0, "DV"); addMapping("DV", 1, 0, "DVB"); addMapping("DV", 0, 1, "DVI"); addMapping("DV", 1, 1, "DVBI") ss = getSampleStyleSheet() base = ParagraphStyle("b", parent=ss["Normal"], fontName="DV", fontSize=8.6, leading=11.4, spaceAfter=3.5) h1 = ParagraphStyle("h1", parent=base, fontName="DVB", fontSize=14.5, leading=18, spaceAfter=6, textColor=colors.HexColor("#08519c")) h2 = ParagraphStyle("h2", parent=base, fontName="DVB", fontSize=11.5, leading=14.5, spaceBefore=9, spaceAfter=4, textColor=colors.HexColor("#08519c")) h3 = ParagraphStyle("h3", parent=base, fontName="DVB", fontSize=9.6, leading=12.5, spaceBefore=6, spaceAfter=3) cell = ParagraphStyle("c", parent=base, fontSize=7.2, leading=9.0, spaceAfter=0) cellh = ParagraphStyle("ch", parent=cell, fontName="DVB") def inline(t): t = t.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") t = re.sub(r"`([^`]+)`", r'\1', t) t = re.sub(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*", r"\1", t) t = re.sub(r"(?\1", t) return t story, lines, i = [], md.splitlines(), 0 W = A4[0] - 30 * mm def flush_list(items, numbered): if not items: return flow = [] for txt, sub in items: paras = [Paragraph(inline(txt), base)] if sub: paras.append(ListFlowable([ListItem(Paragraph(inline(x), base), leftIndent=10) for x in sub], bulletType="bullet", start="–", leftIndent=12, bulletFontName="DV")) flow.append(ListItem(paras, leftIndent=12)) story.append(ListFlowable(flow, bulletType="1" if numbered else "bullet", start=None if numbered else "•", leftIndent=12, bulletFontName="DV", bulletFontSize=8.6)) while i < len(lines): ln = lines[i] if not ln.strip(): i += 1; continue if ln.startswith("# "): story.append(Paragraph(inline(ln[2:]), h1)); i += 1; continue if ln.startswith("## "): story.append(Paragraph(inline(ln[3:]), h2)); i += 1; continue if ln.startswith("### "): story.append(Paragraph(inline(ln[4:]), h3)); i += 1; continue if ln.strip() == "---": story.append(HRFlowable(width="100%", thickness=0.6, color=colors.HexColor("#999999"), spaceBefore=3, spaceAfter=5)); i += 1; continue m = re.match(r"!\[.*?\]\((.+?)\)", ln.strip()) if m: from reportlab.lib.utils import ImageReader path = os.path.join(OUT, m.group(1)); iw, ih = ImageReader(path).getSize() w = W; h = w * ih / iw if h > 105 * mm: h = 105 * mm; w = h * iw / ih story.append(Image(path, width=w, height=h)); story.append(Spacer(1, 4)); i += 1; continue if ln.startswith("|"): rows = [] while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("|"): if not re.match(r"^\|[\s\-|:]+\|$", lines[i]): rows.append([c.strip() for c in lines[i].strip().strip("|").split("|")]) i += 1 ncol = len(rows[0]) lens = [max(len(r[k]) if k < len(r) else 0 for r in rows) for k in range(ncol)] tot = sum(min(L, 160) for L in lens); cw = [W * max(min(L, 160), 12) / (tot + 12 * ncol) for L in lens] cw = [c * W / sum(cw) for c in cw] data = [[Paragraph(inline(c), cellh if r_i == 0 else cell) for c in r] for r_i, r in enumerate(rows)] t = Table(data, colWidths=cw, repeatRows=1) t.setStyle(TableStyle([("GRID", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.4, colors.HexColor("#aaaaaa")), ("BACKGROUND", (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.HexColor("#e8eef6")), ("VALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "TOP"), ("LEFTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 3), ("RIGHTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 3), ("TOPPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 2), ("BOTTOMPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 2)])) story.append(t); story.append(Spacer(1, 5)); continue if re.match(r"^(- |\d+\. )", ln): numbered = bool(re.match(r"^\d+\. ", ln)); items = [] while i < len(lines) and (re.match(r"^(- |\d+\. )", lines[i]) or re.match(r"^ - ", lines[i])): if re.match(r"^ - ", lines[i]): items[-1][1].append(lines[i][4:]) else: items.append([re.sub(r"^(- |\d+\. )", "", lines[i]), []]) i += 1 flush_list(items, numbered); continue story.append(Paragraph(inline(ln), base)); i += 1 def footer(canvas, doc): canvas.saveState(); canvas.setFont("DV", 7); canvas.setFillColor(colors.grey) canvas.drawString(15 * mm, 8 * mm, "AX-1177 portfolio-audit position — based solely on delivered datasets mmc2–mmc5 and Methods Annex") canvas.drawRightString(A4[0] - 15 * mm, 8 * mm, f"page {doc.page}"); canvas.restoreState() doc = SimpleDocTemplate(f"{OUT}/AX-1177_portfolio_audit_memo.pdf", pagesize=A4, leftMargin=15 * mm, rightMargin=15 * mm, topMargin=13 * mm, bottomMargin=14 * mm, title="AX-1177 portfolio-audit position", author="Portfolio analytics") doc.build(story, onFirstPage=footer, onLaterPages=footer) print("PDF written") if __name__ == "__main__": (render_pdf if (len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "pdf") else render_html)()
